Agent Name: WebSurfer  
Step Number: 1  
Reason for Mistake: WebSurfer failed to efficiently identify and focus on restaurants that explicitly meet the criteria of offering vegan mains under $15 within 1 block of Washington Square Park. Instead, WebSurfer repeatedly explored irrelevant or upscale restaurants unlikely to meet the price point, resulting in wasted steps and failure to obtain the correct solution. This inefficiency ultimately led to incorrect answers and delayed progress in solving the problem.
